title: Litl Sneaky 510 Battery
description:
The Litl Sneaky is a discreet yet versatile 510 thread battery that doesn’t compromise on core functionality. The Sneaky suits users who value adjustable control in a compact design, especially if you prioritize the flexibility of switching between button and auto-draw activation for different situations. It’s ideal for those seeking reliable all-day cartridge performance, whether you’re new to vaping or simply want an uncomplicated, pocket-friendly backup.

The Litl Sneaky 510 Battery delivers advanced functionality in an intuitive package. Its bright LCD screen provides clear real-time monitoring of voltage, session duration, and battery status, while the dynamic LED indicator offers visual feedback during use. The device offers versatile operation through dual activation modes (button or auto-draw), adapting effortlessly to your preferred vaping style.

Key Features:
LCD Color Display
Precise Voltage Control
Puff Counter
Auto & Manual Activation Modes
Real Time Session Timer
Pre Heat Function
Cartridge not included

Purposefully cable-free. Most clients have a USB-C cable already. No clutter, no waste.
If you need one — we’ve got options.

Experience precise customization with adjustable voltage settings, perfect for dialing in richer flavor at lower voltages or denser vapor at higher settings. The 10-second pre-heat function helps optimize concentrate viscosity for consistently smooth draws. It also helps unclog your cart when needed.

Built for daily use, the Sneaky features a durable polycarbonate chassis with a comfortable rubberized finish. The 630mAh battery supports extended moderate sessions, while USB-C charging ensures rapid power replenishment. These elements create a reliable, user-focused device that balances performance with practicality.

About LITL Sneaky
Real-Time Session Timer: Displays your active vaping time in seconds.
LCD Color Display: Provides clear, real-time information at a glance.
Cartridge Resistance Display: Shows the resistance of the attached cart/chamber for optimal performance.
Puff Counter: Tracks your usage for monitoring and consistency.
510 Thread Compatibility: Works seamlessly with a wide range of cartridges and accessories.
Precise Voltage Control: Adjustable from 1.8V to 4.2V for customized vapor production.
Pre-Heat Function: Primes your material in 10 seconds for quick starts or unclogging potential.
Dual Activation Modes: Choose between manual button press or automatic draw activation.
630 mAh Battery Capacity: Ensures extended use.
USB-C Charging: Offers quick and convenient recharging.
Compact & Lightweight Design: Maximizes portability and discreetness.
Iceborn Compatibility: Allows for cooler, smoother draws with external cooling systems.
